name: Initial System
changes: Initial rule set: rule-based regime model (6 regimes), 6 screener setups + news/price mismatch, 1.5×ATR stops, ≥2:1 reward/risk, options only when they beat the stock on risk/reward, risk limits 1% per trade / 5% total / 15% options / 15% single position.
reason: Starting point for the paper-trading desk.
evidence: None yet: this is the untested baseline. Rules come from standard practice, not from this desk's results.
expected_effect: Unknown. Establish a measurable baseline; first statistical review at 20 closed trades.

name: Intelligence Layer
changes: Adds an analysis and recording layer only: composite market-regime database (point-in-time, 3y), point-in-time screener backtest with overlapping signals removed, rejected-trade and opportunity-cost tracking, analytical-error database, evidence-gated pattern database, formal experiments (baseline vs alternative), prediction calibration buckets with magnitude and timing accuracy, benchmarks for every trade, multi-asset event reactions (1h/1d/1w/1m), company and sector intelligence files, and a strategy-weighted decision scorecard (new config key 'scorecard'). NO change to screening, entry/stop/target, options rules, sizing or risk limits (1%/5%/15%/15% unchanged).
reason: Samanyu's add-on specification (2026-10-07): learn from trades taken AND not taken, measure calibration, avoid hindsight bias and overfitting.
evidence: Not evidence-based: this is infrastructure. Scorecard weights are judgment-based starting values; experiment X3 tests whether the score predicts outcomes before it may influence ranking.
expected_effect: Better-measured decisions and earlier detection of what works; no direct effect on trade selection until a pattern or experiment is validated and approved.
